summary.text: If the Public Trustee cannot administer the estate, engage a lawyer to apply for Letters of Administration.

steps.name: Engage a lawyer
steps.text: If the Public Trustee cannot administer the estate, engage a lawyer to apply for Letters of Administration so you can administer the estate yourself.

steps.name: Get the renunciation letter
steps.text: Ask the Public Trustee for its letter renouncing the Government's right to apply for Letters of Administration.

sources.page_title: What is the process after Minister for Law has approved equitable or moral claim against a bona vacantia estate?

quotes.text: you will have to engage a lawyer to apply for Letters of Administration so that you can administer the estate on your own.

For estates which we cannot administer due to reasons stated in "What are the situations where the Public Trustee cannot act?", you will have to engage a lawyer to apply for Letters of Administration so that you can administer the estate on your own.
We will provide you with a renunciation letter renouncing the Government's right to apply for Letters of Administration.
